card.title: Failure Reveals the Mission
card.instruction: Use each failed step to reveal a different goal the plan was secretly pursuing, then act immediately on that new mission.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The treasure map ends at this solid wall. It secretly led us here to wake it. I'm knocking.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nothing. And our torch is nearly out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we were sent to hear it in darkness. I'm putting the torch out.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can only hear you breathing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's it. The map was testing our breath control. I'm holding mine.

card.title: Failure Reveals the Mission
card.instruction: Use each failed step to reveal a different goal the plan was secretly pursuing, then act immediately on that new mission.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Base can't hear our ship's report. We were secretly sent to receive. I'm switching channels.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Still static. I need the weather forecast before my watch.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then this was a repair exam. I'm opening the casing.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's full of seawater. Water's coming under the door too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The real assignment was evacuation practice. I'm launching the lifeboat; bring the examination log.

card.title: Raise the Impossibility
card.instruction: Answer every strange offer with a more committed version that you can still justify.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For my restaurant, your flying chair needs a flying table. Dinner should travel with the diner.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can make the whole table circle the room.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Add a hovering waiter. Nobody should chase their soup.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The waiter can serve while flying upside down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then commission gravity-proof soup. I won't make customers rotate between courses.

card.title: Raise the Impossibility
card.instruction: Answer every strange offer with a more committed version that you can still justify.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your invisible guest is welcome at our wedding. I'll reserve places for invisible companions.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Her family can walk through walls. They tend to wander.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll rent a ballroom that follows them. Nobody should miss cake.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Our ballroom can split itself when guests wander apart.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll order a cake that multiplies with it. Every room deserves the first slice.

card.title: Every Glitch Is a Gift
card.instruction: Turn every contradiction or failure into a surprising benefit of the impossible system.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our garden door opens into the broom cupboard. Wonderful, we can take a brush for the picnic crumbs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now it's the attic. I'm carrying all the sandwiches.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Perfect. Grab the picnic blanket without climbing stairs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now it's the cellar. The sandwiches are getting warm.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Built-in refrigeration. Put them beside the wine; this door is catering.

card.title: Every Glitch Is a Gift
card.instruction: Turn every contradiction or failure into a surprising benefit of the impossible system.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The office clock is dragging us backward. Excellent, we can attend the meeting we missed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Too far. I haven't received the invitation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Extra preparation time. This clock understands workload.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now it's before the booking. The boss wants my opinion: do we need this meeting?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Perfect. Tell her no. We've upgraded from attending on time to giving everyone their afternoon back.

card.title: Impossible Currency
card.instruction: Price every favor in symbolic acts, imaginary resources, or promises that cannot be measured normally.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Borrow my ladder for one shadow until Friday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need my shadow at work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep its office hours. I'll take its evenings.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you hold the ladder too? I'm afraid of heights.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For that, leave me your fear of falling. I'll keep it until you're down; you can climb without it.

card.title: Impossible Currency
card.instruction: Price every favor in symbolic acts, imaginary resources, or promises that cannot be measured normally.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll fix the kettle for a spoonful of yesterday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How do I give you yesterday?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Start with the five minutes you wasted this morning.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's today.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then leave it overnight. I can wait for the currency to mature.

card.title: Yes, Under My Physics
card.instruction: Agree completely, then redefine each term using rules that make your preferred outcome inevitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Absolutely, I'll move forward for the photo. Forward means facing the camera; I'm perfectly placed in this shade.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need you two feet closer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. Feet are units of zoom. Increase yours by two.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now only your face fits.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. A full portrait means all the important parts. You've captured me completely.

card.title: Yes, Under My Physics
card.instruction: Agree completely, then redefine each term using rules that make your preferred outcome inevitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Absolutely, I'll help move your boxes downstairs. Help means saving effort; I'll call the lift.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's broken. Carry that box yourself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. Yourself means without involving you. I'll hire a mover.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. You're paying him.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Agreed. Paying means settling what I owe. He charges for heavy lifting; I've lifted nothing, so my balance is zero.

card.title: Co-Sign This
card.instruction: Get someone to help by making them an official participant who shares responsibility for the outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you co-sign the form for borrowing this barbecue?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll help carry it. That handle looks cracked.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good eye. Sign as joint custodian; we'll inspect it together.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The owner wants a replacement by Sunday if it breaks.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you're co-chair of replacements too. I'll call the shops; you approve what we buy before either of us promises her anything.

card.title: Co-Sign This
card.instruction: Get someone to help by making them an official participant who shares responsibility for the outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've made you co-organizer of Saturday's school trip. Can you approve the bus route?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only volunteered to drive. Your route misses the museum.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good catch. Correct it and initial it; then we both own the plan.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll fix it, but you explain any delays to the parents.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Together. I'll introduce you as our transport lead and take the questions beside you.

card.title: Close It Properly
card.instruction: Keep them present until both of you complete the ritual that formally ends this role, meeting, or relationship.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you leave tonight's book club, we close the discussion together.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I said goodnight. My taxi's coming.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll say 'chapter closed'; you answer 'until next time.' Then we can leave.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's here. I'll say my bit from the car.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll come to the window for mine. Keep it open; I'm not adjourning through glass like a visiting relative.

card.title: Close It Properly
card.instruction: Keep them present until both of you complete the ritual that formally ends this role, meeting, or relationship.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you hand in your shop keys, we do the farewell bell.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm leaving because the bell rings constantly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Precisely. This is the last one you have to answer.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. Ring it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We ring it together. Leaving is still a team activity.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: If the chair flies, my paperclip needs its own flying tray.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's one tiny paperclip.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. We can't risk losing it in ordinary turbulence.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The chair can hover gently.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then commission a hovering security guard. Gentle air still has thieves.

bespokePairs.seedUse: The prized paperclip or exact wording becomes the reason to escalate the unusual premise, avoiding unrelated props in the old compiler.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your invisible guest must sign this register using 'regards,' not 'best regards.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can't see the signature.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we need invisible ink that becomes visible specifically for 'regards.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's a very particular invention.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And an invisible proofreader. I won't trust one miraculous spelling check.

card.title: The Important Thing
card.instruction: Choose one ordinary object, phrase, or rule and treat it as vitally important. Keep bringing the scene back to it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nobody moves out until I find the paperclip from my desk.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The removal van is charging by the hour.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then make the driver help look.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The landlord wants the keys.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: He can have the building. I want the paperclip.

card.title: Raise the Impossibility
card.instruction: Answer every strange offer with a more committed version that you can still justify.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A flying chair needs a flying table. Where else will it eat?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: One flying chair is enough.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Enough for sitting. We're discussing hospitality.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then a flying table.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And a hovering waiter. We can't keep making it land for soup.

card.title: The Important Thing
card.instruction: Choose one ordinary object, phrase, or rule and treat it as vitally important. Keep bringing the scene back to it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You changed 'regards' to 'best regards' in my email.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I also got us the contract.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We can discuss that after removing 'best.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll send a correction. Shall I withdraw the whole email?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Just withdraw 'best.' I don't want them thinking I've withdrawn my regards.

card.title: Raise the Impossibility
card.instruction: Answer every strange offer with a more committed version that you can still justify.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our invisible guest will need places for the entourage.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We only invited one guest.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can't expect them to leave invisible companions outside.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How many places?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Set the room. We'll count the untouched plates afterward.
